We would like to point out that the 3860.77 ˚A unidenti- ﬁed line also appears in the spectrum of CS 22892-052, whereas it does not in other giants of similar metallicity and temperature which have no excess of neutron-capture elements. We therefore tentatively attribute this absorp- tion feature to an neutron-capture element, and encourage atomic physicists to work on the identiﬁcation of this fea- ture. We also note here that there are numerous features in the whole UV part of the spectrum of neutron-capture enriched giants, that are still in need of identiﬁcation.
